extra.label: GENIUS ACT STABLECOIN DEADLINE MISSED — REGULATORY VOID EXTENDS INTO 2027
extra.value: U.S. regulators (Federal Reserve, OCC, FDIC, NCUA, Treasury) missed the July 18, 2026 statutory one-year deadline to finalize stablecoin rules under the GENIUS Act (signed July 18, 2025). None of the five agencies produced final regulations. The GENIUS Act includes no fallback, no automatic implementation, and no interim guidance — leaving stablecoin issuers in a legal void with January 2027 enforcement approaching. The missed deadline extends uncertainty into at least H2 2026 and potentially 2027, meaning the stablecoin industry operates without a federal framework for at least two years after Congress acted. For BTC: (a) delays institutionalization of the broader crypto market infrastructure; (b) adds regulatory uncertainty heading into the CLARITY Act debate; (c) is a secondary bearish signal — the CLARITY Act remains the primary BTC regulatory catalyst and is on track for a Senate floor vote this week.
